title.narrative: UNICEF enhanced its capacity for socially inclusive programming by mapping stakeholders for collaboration around disability and gender inclusion, and developing a strategy to coordinate efforts addressing the needs of Children Affected by Migration across programmes. UNICEF also deployed effective change strategies, integrating child rights and business principles as well as social and behavioural change elements into various sectors. Through partnerships with the ILO and EU, UNICEF accelerated efforts to tackle child labour and contributed to the formation of the National Action Plan on Business and Human Rights. Additionally, UNICEF continues to support three C4D centres, which have formed a national alliance for behavioural insights.
